description: Voronoi-partition the space — one cell per vertex, or per random seed (uncheck 'Use vertices'). Rectilinear = BSP-like axis-aligned cells (concave-safe). Relax = Lloyd/CVT.
instructions:
Voronoi-partitions the Space. Seed source: the polygon's vertices (`useVertices` on → one cell per vertex) or `seeds` random interior points (off). `metric` = Euclidean / Manhattan / Chebyshev (the latter two give blockier cells). `relax` runs Lloyd/CVT relaxation; `rectilinear` produces BSP-like axis-aligned (staircase) cells oriented to the principal axis (concave-safe).

One output handle per cell, or a single bundle (`outputMode`). Seed count is wireable. NOTE: the live cell count bakes on evaluation.
